Local binding rebuild + pytest + both repo checks continue under staged monitor ydm5j1.

Pin sase-core-revision.txt already at eabe416c; no new binding added so no pin move needed from this phase; core commit landing brings the fix.

Owner enrichment at settle verified: stage-before-settle backfills possible_owners/newest_owners (sase-probe, matched_on location) with classification evidence byte-identical; show and failures agree across all four classes; replay/empty-gather preserve; false owners rejected; suppressed runs skipped. sase tool run check exit 0 (run 33845e68, full suite), sase-core tool run check exit 0 (run d8849134). payload.entry: VERIFIED candidate_projection. Rust: new sase_core::bead::triage_owners (policy + replay lane) and bead::read_model::triage_owners (indexed lane: issue_type/task_type/created_at columns + json_extract of title, closed_at, task_type_fields.node_id/location; no IssueWire decode). Binding bead_triage_owner_candidates(beads_dir, now_ts=None) releases the GIL; registered, round-trip tested, added to REQUIRED_BINDINGS. Python: bead_read_facade.triage_owner_candidates (require_rust_binding, no fallback); gather_owner_candidates now only resolves the store and transports candidates+diagnostics, honors now_ts, fails open; locator contract (bare stage label like "lint (symvision)" unsupported) documented. No candidate cap; 1s slice and 5s budget unchanged. Tests: Rust 8 triage_owners (policy, every status, recent/edge/expired/unknown/garbled/naive closes, now_ts, node-over-location, cached==replay with store_io_stats reads/snapshot_loads/full_replays all 0, five-key wire, classifier wire + match_owners, stage-label negative) + 1 binding round-trip; Python 10 in tests/tool/test_triage_owner_candidates.py (matches retired Python policy at 4 now_ts values, no Python hydration with list_issues/issue_from_dict/issues_from_list patched to raise, missing store, binding raise, diagnostics, stage-label settle negative) + 2 new executor regressions (unavailable store diagnostic keeps exit 9; stored owner survives empty-gather re-settle) + existing timeout regression. CLI acceptance (tests/tool/test_triage_owner_cli_acceptance.py, real subprocess sase tool run check -> tool runs -j -> tool show -j -> tool failures -t check -j, isolated SASE_HOME and cache-backed event store, real tools/run_silent + failing pytest, nothing mocked): failing node tests/test_owner_probe.py::test_owner, fixture owner fx-1; stage-first run 3ce7c0e8fcf8edc9d1e9647c81a20a3f exit 1, decision stop/known; fresh-settle run 6615bbcdcafb7956a93a78af0df05489 exit 1, decision stop/never; both class unknown with label.possible_owners == newest_owners == [{id: fx-1, status: open, reason: possible owner, matched_on: location}]. Fixture dirs removed; live ledger untouched.
